# Planned offline fixtures

PL-08 and PK-02 require tiny reviewed originals for each used format, paired
normalized texts with NFC/code-point edge cases, source trees/revision relations,
equivalent-rule groups, accepted/rejected draft cases, separate public cases and
restricted gold, fixed ranks and vector maps, two snapshots and labeled update
events. Cover no-edit, metadata-only, add/edit/delete, changed breadcrumbs,
shared-vector deletion, incomplete cache entries, checkpoint changes and crashes.

Provide exact serialized contexts with complementary/overlapping spans, known
alternative evidence sets (including empty and multi-atom cases), mocked Qwen and
DeepSeek success/error/identity-change responses, blind human labels, unscored
verdicts and uncertain/retried request ledgers. Bind every fixture to a manifest
and expected deterministic outcome. No fixture data or runnable tests exist yet.
